sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Official APIs to query. Companies House requires an API key; SEC EDGAR works without a key.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Company name, ticker, or broad search term.

companyNames.title: Company names
companyNames.description: Optional list of company names or tickers to search.

companyNumbers.title: Companies House numbers
companyNumbers.description: Optional direct UK Companies House company numbers.

maxResults.title: Maximum records
maxResults.description: Maximum clean company/entity records to save.

companiesHouseApiKey.title: Companies House API key
companiesHouseApiKey.description: Free Companies House API key. Required only when UK Companies House is selected. You may also set COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY.

secUserAgent.title: SEC User-Agent
secUserAgent.description: SEC requires a descriptive User-Agent. Replace contact@example.com with your contact email for production use.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Not required for official JSON APIs, included for Apify compatibility.
